mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM video v JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.owner_id WHERE v.id = #{videoId} AND v.status = 1 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT p.id, p.author_id, p.content, p.title, p.image_urls, v.id AS video_id, p.is_pinned, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.share_count, p.created_at, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, u.signature AS author_signature, v.title AS video_title, v.cover_url AS video_cover, v.duration_seconds AS video_duration, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM watch_later wl WHERE wl.video_id = p.video_id AND wl.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS watch_later FROM user_post p JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.author_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN video v ON v.id = p.video_id AND v.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 1 AND (p.visibility = 0 OR p.author_id = #{viewerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_follow SET last_seen_post_at=NOW(3) WHERE follower_id=#{viewerId} AND followee_id=#{targetUserId}
